cues.label: Forth valley seen from high on a sunny morning: wide airy wind bed, distant birds, far-off farm life; opens under the music, no foreground sounds
soft camera whoosh as the view snaps from the hill across to the river loop and the bridge (on "เจ็ดร้อยกว่าปีก่อน", 6.57 s)
English camp bustle: tent canvas flapping, banners fluttering, a distant crowd murmur, a cooking fire crackling, harness jingle
four to six caparisoned horses walking past on grass and trodden earth: soft hoof clops (walk cycle 40 frames), a bit of chain mail and harness jingle, no voices
swift pan whoosh with a low rumble of hooves on "เต็มทุ่ง" (9.26 s) as the camp parade sweeps across the frame
soft airy swell for the dissolve from the camp to the Scots on the hill (g 293-303, centre 298)
Scots on the hill: open high wind through heather and gorse, a lark or two, a creak of leather, calm and tense; no music hit
short pull-out whoosh on "ส่วนใหญ่เดินเท้า" (10.59 s)
faint spear shafts shifting against each other, boots on dry grass (one or two, quiet)
river from the south bank: gentle lapping water along reeds, cattail rustle, a distant duck, soft wind
camera pan whoosh over the water toward the hill on "อีกฝั่งของแม่น้ำ" (12.73 s)
two English footmen at the water edge: armour creak and a boot shifting on the bank, very quiet
